profile_text.body:
IBM, founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, is a publicly traded enterprise technology company (NYSE: IBM) with reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The company's OpenPages product is described on its site as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform designed to help organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in a single integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises. The site describes OpenPages as offering a modular approach to governance, risk, and compliance, with embedded AI that automates classification and issue creation, and an OpenPages MCP Server intended to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed workflows. The site also notes a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and automated documentation; IBM watsonx.governance, which provides AI lifecycle governance including model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation with EU AI Act accelerators; and IBM watsonx, described as a model-agnostic enterprise AI platform that incorporates agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site states that OpenPages integrates with watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through an API-based architecture. IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026, and the site also references IBM being recognized as a leader in the IDC MarketScape for Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

The held facts confirm IBM holds SEC filings under CIK 0000051143 and carries no tracked litigation in the dataset at this time.
